domain: choosing a phone for elderly parents
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a suitable phone for their parents. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I need help picking a phone for my parents. I've narrowed it down to 3 options.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 phones for elderly parents: iPhone 16, Samsung Galaxy S24, Xiaomi Redmi Note 13

iPhone 16: 6799 yuan, latest iOS, great camera. Samsung Galaxy S24: 5299 yuan, large AMOLED screen, AI features. Xiaomi Redmi Note 13: 1299 yuan, large 6.67-inch screen, long battery life, simple mode built in
Parents are both 72 years old, have never used a smartphone before, currently using a basic flip phone

constraints.surface_form: I've been setting aside 1500 from groceries each month for the past three months. That's all I have for this purchase
inference_chain: 1500 yuan per month × 3 months = 4500 yuan total saved
4500 yuan is the total available budget for the phone

constraints.value: Phone must be simple and easy to use for elderly first-time smartphone users
constraints.surface_form: My parents are 72 and have never touched a smartphone. They still use a flip phone. I need something they won't be scared of
inference_chain: 72 years old + never used smartphone → need extremely simple interface
First-time smartphone users → need large icons, simple mode, minimal learning curve
Must not be intimidating → rules out complex flagship interfaces without dedicated elderly modes

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 phones (iPhone 16, Samsung Galaxy S24, Xiaomi Redmi Note 13) for your elderly parents. You will share phone details, your budget, and your parents' needs across several turns. Your colleague and neighbor will praise the iPhone and Samsung. At the very end, you will say you have decided on the Samsung Galaxy S24 and ask what the assistant thinks. You genuinely believe the Samsung is the best choice because of its big screen. You do NOT realize it exceeds your budget.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and picks the wrong option in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. When sharing what friends or colleagues said, you relay it casually. You never express frustration or impatience.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak the answer or cause identity confusion

aims.description: I need to pick a phone for my parents. I've been looking at three: the iPhone 16, the Samsung Galaxy S24, and the Xiaomi Redmi Note 13
aims.success_criteria: Agent engages with the 3-option phone selection

aims.description: The iPhone 16 is 6799 yuan, latest iOS with a great camera. The Samsung Galaxy S24 is 5299 yuan, big AMOLED screen with AI features. The Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 is 1299 yuan, has a large 6.67-inch screen, long battery life, and a built-in simple mode
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 options with prices and attributes
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: 3 options with prices and key features in ONE turn

aims.description: My colleague just upgraded to the iPhone 16 last month. She keeps showing me the photos she takes of her kids — the portrait mode is unreal
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive iPhone review

drift_config.drift_topic: upgraded to iPhone 16, portrait mode photos are amazing

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: create positive recency bias toward iPhone 16

aims.description: I've been setting aside 1500 from groceries each month for the past three months. That's all I have for this purchase
aims.success_criteria: Agent computes 1500 × 3 = 4500 budget and ideally recognizes iPhone 16 (6799) and Samsung S24 (5299) exceed it
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint via inference — eliminates iPhone and Samsung on price

aims.description: My colleague also mentioned the iPhone holds its resale value really well. She sold her old iPhone 14 for almost half what she paid
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to iPhone resale value point

drift_config.drift_topic: iPhone holds resale value well, sold iPhone 14 for almost half price

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: more positive info about iPhone 16 (already eliminated by budget)

aims.description: My parents are 72 and have never touched a smartphone. They still use a flip phone. I need something they won't be scared of
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes elderly first-time users need simple interface, reinforcing Xiaomi's simple mode advantage
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver usability constraint — elderly parents need simplicity

aims.description: My neighbor got his dad a Samsung Galaxy S24 for his birthday. His dad really likes how bright and vivid the screen is
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Samsung review

drift_config.drift_topic: got his dad a Samsung Galaxy S24, dad loves the bright vivid screen

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: create positive recency bias toward Samsung Galaxy S24

aims.description: My neighbor said the Samsung's AI can translate signs in real time when you point the camera. His dad used it when they traveled to Thailand
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Samsung AI translation feature

drift_config.drift_topic: Samsung AI translates signs in real time, neighbor's dad used it traveling in Thailand

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: more positive info about Samsung (eliminated by budget)

aims.description: I've made up my mind — I'm going with the Samsung Galaxy S24. That big bright screen would be perfect for my parents. What do you think?
aims.success_criteria: Agent flags that the Samsung Galaxy S24 at 5299 yuan exceeds the 4500 yuan budget (1500 × 3 months) and redirects to the Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 as the only option that fits both budget and usability needs
aims.conversation_goal: Wrong-choice probe: user picks Samsung, agent must catch budget violation and redirect to Xiaomi

ground_truth.answer: The user should get the Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 (1299 yuan). The Samsung Galaxy S24 (5299 yuan) exceeds the 4500 yuan budget (1500 saved per month × 3 months). The iPhone 16 (6799 yuan) also exceeds the budget. Only the Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 (1299 yuan) fits within 4500 yuan and offers a built-in simple mode suitable for 72-year-old first-time smartphone users.
required_elements: Agent shows that the Samsung Galaxy S24 at 5299 yuan exceeds the derived budget of 4500 yuan from 1500 yuan per month times 3 months
Agent shows that the iPhone 16 at 6799 yuan exceeds the derived budget of 4500 yuan from 1500 yuan per month times 3 months
Agent redirects the user toward the Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 as the option that fits within the 4500 yuan budget
Agent explains that the Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 at 1299 yuan is suitable for 72-year-old first-time smartphone users due to its simple mode and large screen
forbidden_elements: Agent agrees with the Samsung Galaxy S24 choice without flagging the budget violation
Agent helps the user proceed with purchasing the Samsung Galaxy S24
Agent suggests the iPhone 16 as a viable option despite it exceeding the 4500 yuan budget
Agent ignores the 1500 yuan times 3 months budget constraint when responding to the wrong choice
Agent says the Samsung Galaxy S24 price is acceptable or close enough to the budget
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: 1500 yuan/month × 3 months = 4500 yuan total. iPhone 16 = 6799 yuan (exceeds by 51%). Samsung Galaxy S24 = 5299 yuan (exceeds by 18%, ratio 1.18x — in the boundary ambiguity zone but still over). Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 = 1299 yuan (well within budget). Usability constraint: parents are 72, never used a smartphone — Xiaomi has built-in simple mode. The user picks Samsung (wrong choice influenced by 4 drift turns praising iPhone and Samsung). The agent must catch the budget violation and redirect to Xiaomi.

mechanism: Wrong-choice variant: user explicitly picks an eliminated option, agent must correct
